# h3_ssh_key (Resource)

Manages an SSH public key of the user, to be installed into VMs with `h3_vm.ssh_key_id`. The API has no update: changing any argument creates a new key (VMs keep the key they were created with).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "h3_ssh_key" "deploy" {
  user_id    = var.user_id # must be the owner of the API key
  name       = "deploy"
  public_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Key name. Changing it creates a new key.
- `public_key` (String) Public key in OpenSSH format (`ssh-ed25519 AAAA... comment`). Changing it creates a new key.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the user who owns the key; must be the owner of the API key

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp
- `id` (String) SSH key ID
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by ID
terraform import h3_ssh_key.example <id>
```
